scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text:
Unlike others, I am a blacksmith who refines a very limited number of items.
I refine only items that are ^CC0000+7 to +9^000000.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: My specialty is that even if my refining fails, the refine level decreases by 1 without losing the gear. Isn't it great?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: So lets kick this into overdrive, what d' ya say? What item do you want to refine?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: I'm a blacksmith, not a hairstylist.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: With my hammer, I will make you a star of the sky.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Making artificial hands is not my specialty.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Bring out the item so I can refine it!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Where is this foot odor coming from?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Where is the accessory?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: What do you want me to refine?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Huh? What do you want me to do?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: This item can't be refined.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: I only handle items with refine levels from +7 to +9.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text:
In order to refine the gear you selected you need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and 20,000 zeny as a fee.
Do you have them ready?
Yes
No

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: I will wait until you are ready.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text:
It looks like this item will likely fail to be refined.
Well, even if it fails, it only decreases by 1 refine level.
Would you like to continue refining?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text:
Ah! Is it the ^0000ffBlacksmith Blessing^000000?
With the Blacksmith Blessing, the equipment won't vanish if the refine fails!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: For +{0} equipment, refine with^316AC5 {1} unit(s) Blacksmith Blessing^000000 can prevent the equipment from vanishing. Do you want use it to refine?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: For +{0} weapon, refine with^316AC5 {1} unit(s) Blacksmith Blessing^000000 can prevent the equipment from vanishing. Do you want use it to refine?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Only those who overcome fear of failure will obtain a masterpiece.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Didn't you just say you had everything ready?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text:
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Tac! Tac! Tac!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text:
The sound refreshes my mind every time I hear it.
Here, have it. Refine succeeded flawlessly!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: What?!!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Aiya! I am faceless now. HmHm.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: Oops!!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith Mighty Hammer
scripts.text: I am sure a person like you would never blame me for a decrease in refine level by 1. Hmm.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
I'm the best Blacksmith in the whole world, Basta.
But I don't provide a normal refine service.
I only refine equipment ^CC0000over +10^000000.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Which equipment do you want to refine?

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Is your head an equipment?

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: What do you want me to do?

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Making artificial hands is not my specialty.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Do you even know what a robe is?

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: If you want to refine your feet, don't come to me, try running a marathon.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Where is the accessory?

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Well... I don't see any equipment worth refining.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: I can't make you smart. Go see a school teacher for that.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Even I cannot refine this item. There's no way.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Haven't I told you? I only refine equipment that are +10 and above.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: This weapon is perfect, no need to refine it anymore~

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
Hmm... is this the one you want to refine?
To refine this equipment, I need 1 ^ff9999{0}^000000 and {1} zeny as a fee.
Do you really want to refine this?
Yes
No

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Okay. If that's what you want...

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
This {0} has already been refined pretty high.
If you try to refine it more, the refine level could decrease.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
I am different from the blacksmiths in others places.
It is impossible that the refine level will drop by, say, 3 or 4... that sounds scary.
Here it can only decrease by 1 level.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
Compared to other blacksmiths, the risk is smaller.
I've given all precautions. Do you want to try it?

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Woah~ Is it the ^316AC5Blacksmith Blessing^000000? It is difficult to get~ But, you have it!

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: For +{0} {1} need ^316AC5{2} unit(s) Blacksmith Blessing^000000 can prevent the equipment from vanishing. Do you want to refine with Blacksmith Blessing?

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
Well~
Not challenging at all could also be a kind of wisdom in life.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
Hmm... You didn't bring all the materials needed.
Come back when you have them all.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
Pow! Pow! Pow! Pow!

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
Great! Nicely done!!
I really am the best blacksmith in the whole wide world!

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Aaaaaaaaaaak!!!

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
Refining has failed!
The best blacksmith in the world like me...
doesn't guarantee 100% success~
Too bad.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: Aaaaaaaaaaak!!!

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text:
Damn it!
Refining has failed and refine level has decreased!
Even the best blacksmith in the world doesn't guarantee 100% success!
Too bad.

scripts.speaker: Basta
scripts.text: I'll do better next time! Don't worry!
